w05.title: Strategy Memo – Week 5
w05.author: John (GM)
w05.modeWhy: 99% playoff odds. The #1 seed's bye lifts title odds from ~22% to ~36%, so we invest AND hunt the bye. Points scored matter: they break multi-team ties.
w05.huddle: Revised with the outside consultants' findings; verified Mixon news and claim targets with live ESPN data.

items: 4-0, #1 seed, 410.5 points for (2nd).
Playoffs 99%, #1 seed 56%, +4.0 wins over 8th place.
Bye rivals: Liddle' Schitty (3-1) and Oviedo (3-1). We play Oviedo Wk 10 and Liddle' Wk 13: full lineup both weeks (head-to-head is the first tiebreaker).
Bye crunch: Wk 6 (Washington, Jones), Wk 7 (Allen), Wk 11 (6 starters). Accept a Wk 11 loss rather than spend assets.
We pick 14th of 14; every free agent is on waivers.
Claims: 1) Meyers (unlikely, drop Mariota), 2) Kaden Wetjen, returner (likely, drop Schultz), 3) Cowboys D/ST stream (likely, drop Rams D/ST).
Return yards are free here: Wetjen, Raheim Sanders and Greg Dortch score about 10 a week and are under 2% owned.
QB isn't scarce: stream Rodgers, Watson or Geno for Allen's Wk 7 bye. Maye is off the list.
Edge as the last pick: the free-agent sprint when waivers clear.
Seattle decided NOT to sign Joe Mixon after his physical (Oct 6). Off our list.
Rumor: Seattle linked to a Tony Pollard trade (Liddle' owns him).
Keep Charbonnet as the playoff RB (@PHI, LAR, @CAR). Decide at Wk 8 whether to sell Price after activation.
Shaheed offer is off: 63% of his points are returns we can get free.
Offer Aaron Jones + Brian Robinson (+ Kyle Williams if needed) to JV Squad for Justin Jefferson before he plays Sunday.
Deadline plan: lock targets by Nov 1; daily trade sweeps Dec 1-9 (deadline Dec 9, noon ET).
Josh Jacobs: suspension risk. Cut if it covers Wks 15-17.
Tyreek Hill: Chiefs reached out (Oct 5). Oviedo owns him; a KC deal strengthens a bye rival and hits Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy values.
Ja'Marr Chase concussion timeline drives Meyers' value.
Saquon Barkley back in 1-3 weeks ends any Shipley rental.
Flip to WIN NOW if the cushion over 8th falls to 2 wins.
Outside review graded us: strategy B-, org C+, data C+. Report in the project.
Hired Quinn (QA) for an independent check before anything reaches Joe.
Rich now owns data pipelines; Maya owns the numbers and playoff planning; Tony's trade duties end Dec 9.
Weekly scorecard starts next Tuesday.

Confidence: high on facts and moves, medium on odds and claim outcomes.
